CORE CONCEPT

Late at night inside an old witch's bedroom, Character A tries to light a single candle using one wand. The candle ignites normally at first. Then the magical flame starts consuming every nearby light source, making the room brighter and brighter until Character A must use the wand again to stop it.

SHOT 1 — 0s–6s | DARK ROOM

Old witch's bedroom at night.

Moonlight enters through a narrow window.

Character A sits beside a wooden table.

A single unlit candle stands in front.

Character A tries a normal match.

It breaks.

Character A looks at it.

Throws it gently onto the table.

Raises one wand.

SHOT 2 — 6s–11s | IGNITION

Tight close-up of wand.

Silver-blue magical light builds at the tip.

Cut to low OTS:

WAND TIP → OPEN SPACE → CANDLE WICK.

At 9s, one thin blue-white ray travels directly to the wick.

Contact spark.

The wick ignites with a small realistic flame.

Character A lowers the wand.

Brief satisfied pause.

SHOT 3 — 11s–16s | SOMETHING WRONG

The candle flame suddenly grows slightly taller.

It bends toward an oil lamp nearby.

The oil lamp ignites by itself.

Character A slowly looks toward it.

Then another small candle across the table ignites.

Then another.

Character A's expression becomes quietly concerned.

SHOT 4 — 16s–22s | TOO HUNGRY

The magical flame jumps from one light source to another.

A wall lantern ignites.

A bedside candle ignites.

A fireplace suddenly catches.

The room becomes increasingly bright.

Camera slowly circles Character A without spinning or chaotic movement.

Character A watches every new flame with growing disbelief.

No cartoon reactions.

SHOT 5 — 22s–26s | ENOUGH

Character A raises the wand again.

Points toward the original candle.

The candle flame grows larger instead.

Character A immediately lowers the wand.

Looks annoyed.

Takes one slow breath.

Then points the wand directly at the flame.

SHOT 6 — 26s–30s | SHUT IT DOWN

A soft blue-white pulse travels from the wand.

It touches the flame.

Every magical flame instantly disappears one after another.

The room returns to darkness.

Only moonlight remains.

Character A stands silently.

Then lights the original candle manually with a simple match.

Character A stares at the tiny normal flame.

A quiet exhausted exhale.

End.

AUDIO + MUSIC

Night ambience, faint wind, wood creaks, match snap, wand ignition, magical hum, small flame sounds, multiple ignition sounds, final magical pulse and quiet exhale.

Music: soft piano, acoustic guitar, pizzicato strings and subtle clarinet.

Music becomes gradually more playful as additional lights ignite.

Brief music reduction before final magical shutdown.

No dialogue, vocals, boing, circus music, meme sounds or laugh track.

CAUSALITY

CANDLE UNLIT → NORMAL MATCH FAILS → WAND ACTIVATES → RAY CONTACT → CANDLE IGNIRES → FLAME SPREADS → ROOM FILLS WITH LIGHT → WAND FAILS ONCE → SECOND SPELL → ALL FLAMES STOP → CHARACTER A LIGHTS CANDLE MANUALLY.

CONCEPT CENTRAL

Tard dans la nuit, à l’intérieur de la chambre d’une vieille sorcière, Character A essaie d’allumer une seule bougie avec une baguette. La bougie s’allume normalement au début. Puis la flamme magique commence à absorber toutes les sources de lumière à proximité, rendant la pièce de plus en plus lumineuse jusqu’à ce que Character A doive utiliser à nouveau la baguette pour l’arrêter.

SHOT 1 — 0s–6s | PIÈCE SOMBRE

Chambre d’une vieille sorcière la nuit.

La lumière de la lune entre par une fenêtre étroite.

Character A est assis à côté d’une table en bois.

Une seule bougie éteinte se tient devant lui.

Character A essaie une allumette normale.

Elle se casse.

Character A la regarde.

La jette doucement sur la table.

Lève une baguette.

SHOT 2 — 6s–11s | IGNITION

Gros plan serré sur la baguette.

Une lumière magique argent-bleu se forme à l’extrémité.

Couper vers un low OTS :

EXTRÉMITÉ DE LA BAGUETTE → ESPACE OUVERT → MÈCHE DE LA BOUGIE.

À 9 s, un fin rayon bleu-blanc se dirige directement vers la mèche.

Étincelle au contact.

La mèche s’enflamme avec une petite flamme réaliste.

Character A abaisse la baguette.

Brève pause satisfaite.

SHOT 3 — 11s–16s | QUELQUE CHOSE NE VA PAS

La flamme de la bougie grandit soudain légèrement.

Elle se penche vers une lampe à huile à proximité.

La lampe à huile s’allume toute seule.

Character A tourne lentement le regard vers elle.

Puis une autre petite bougie de l’autre côté de la table s’allume.

Puis une autre.

L’expression de Character A devient discrètement inquiète.

SHOT 4 — 16s–22s | TROP AFFAMÉE

La flamme magique saute d’une source de lumière à l’autre.

Une lanterne murale s’allume.

Une bougie de chevet s’allume.

Une cheminée prend soudain feu.

La pièce devient de plus en plus lumineuse.

La caméra tourne lentement autour de Character A sans mouvement de rotation ni mouvement chaotique.

Character A observe chaque nouvelle flamme avec une incrédulité croissante.

Aucune réaction de dessin animé.

SHOT 5 — 22s–26s | ÇA SUFFIT

Character A lève à nouveau la baguette.

La pointe vers la bougie d’origine.

La flamme de la bougie grandit au lieu de s’éteindre.

Character A abaisse immédiatement la baguette.

A l’air agacé.

Prend une longue respiration.

Puis pointe la baguette directement vers la flamme.

SHOT 6 — 26s–30s | ARRÊT COMPLET

Une douce impulsion bleu-blanc part de la baguette.

Elle touche la flamme.

Toutes les flammes magiques disparaissent instantanément, l’une après l’autre.

La pièce retombe dans l’obscurité.

Seule la lumière de la lune demeure.

Character A reste silencieux.

Puis allume la bougie d’origine manuellement avec une simple allumette.

Character A fixe la petite flamme normale.

Un soupir discret et épuisé.

Fin.

AUDIO + MUSIQUE

Ambiance nocturne, léger vent, craquements du bois, claquement de l’allumette, ignition de la baguette, bourdonnement magique, petits sons de flamme, multiples sons d’allumage, impulsion magique finale et soupir discret.

Musique : piano doux, guitare acoustique, cordes pizzicato et clarinette subtile.

La musique devient progressivement plus joueuse à mesure que d’autres lumières s’allument.

Réduction brève de la musique avant l’arrêt magique final.

Aucun dialogue, chant, boing, musique de cirque, sons de mème ou piste de rires.

CORE CONCEPT

Tarde da noite, dentro do quarto de uma velha bruxa, Character A tenta acender uma única vela usando uma varinha. A vela acende normalmente no início. Depois, a chama mágica começa a consumir todas as fontes de luz próximas, deixando o quarto cada vez mais claro, até que Character A precise usar a varinha novamente para interromper isso.

SHOT 1 — 0s–6s | DARK ROOM

Quarto de uma velha bruxa à noite.

A luz da lua entra por uma janela estreita.

Character A está sentado(a) ao lado de uma mesa de madeira.

Uma única vela apagada está à frente.

Character A tenta usar um fósforo comum.

Ele quebra.

Character A olha para ele.

Joga-o suavemente sobre a mesa.

Ergue uma varinha.

SHOT 2 — 6s–11s | IGNITION

Close-up apertado da varinha.

Uma luz mágica azul-prateada se acumula na ponta.

Corte para low OTS:

PONTA DA VARINHA → ESPAÇO ABERTO → PAVIO DA VELA.

Faísca de contato.

Character A abaixa a varinha.

Breve pausa de satisfação.

A chama da vela de repente cresce um pouco mais.

Ela se inclina em direção a uma lamparina de óleo próxima.

Character A olha lentamente para ela.

Então outra pequena vela do outro lado da mesa se acende.

Depois outra.

A expressão de Character A passa a ser de preocupação contida.

SHOT 4 — 16s–22s | TOO HUNGRY

A chama mágica salta de uma fonte de luz para outra.

Uma lanterna na parede se acende.

Uma vela ao lado da cama se acende.

Uma lareira de repente pega fogo.

O quarto fica cada vez mais iluminado.

A câmera circula lentamente Character A sem girar ou fazer movimento caótico.

Character A observa cada nova chama com crescente incredulidade.

Sem reações cartunescas.

SHOT 5 — 22s–26s | ENOUGH

Character A ergue a varinha novamente.

Aponta para a vela original.

A chama da vela cresce ainda mais.

Character A imediatamente abaixa a varinha.

Olha irritado(a).

Um pulso suave azul-branco viaja da varinha.

Ele toca a chama.

Todas as chamas mágicas desaparecem instantaneamente, uma após a outra.

O quarto volta à escuridão.

Apenas a luz da lua permanece.

Character A fica em silêncio.

Então acende a vela original manualmente com um fósforo simples.

Character A encara a pequena chama normal.

Um suspiro silencioso e exausto.

短暂满意地停顿。
